• Partecipazione attiva alla nostra offerta terapeutica in geriatria e eurologia complessa (ad esempio parkinson, multimorbidità, prevenzione della caduta)

• Allenamento completo come fisioterapista (SRK accreditato) o fisioterapia di scapolo
• Motivazione o prima esperienza in geriatrico e/o neurologia. La passione conta più di anni di esperienza

• Digital fit e aperto alla comunicazione moderna nel team

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks
• Physiotherapeutic treatment of patients in acute and neurological complex treatment (stationary)
• Interdisciplinary cooperation in case reviews, therapy planning and quality development
• Active participation in our therapy offer in geriatrics and complex eurology (e.g. parkinson, multimorbidity, fall prevention)
• Care of outpatient patients with muskuloskelettalem focus
• Optional: engagement in the training of physiotherapy students
• Exchange in the team, participation in training and space for their own ideas Ideally, first experience or special motivation for work in geriatrics and/or neurology
• You work on evidence-based, responsible and bring professional curiosity with you
• You feel safe in handling digital documentation and modern team communication
• You like to take responsibility and want to introduce yourself professionally and organizationally
• Flexible working hours? Do we find together – we support you in your work-life balance Ready for a new challenge with low gear? Then we look forward to your application
• Complete training as a physiotherapist (SRK-accredited) or bachelor physiotherapy
• Motivation or first experience in geriatric and/or neurology. Passion counts more than years of experience
• You work evidence-based, responsibly and bring professional curiosity with
• Digital fit and open to modern communication in the team
• You value a dynamic, value-adding environment and you want to develop professionally
• Flexible working hours? Let's find together. We support your work-life balance Personal, family, Competent In the regional and supra-regional health network, the Spital Zofingen takes an important role. With more than 750 employees and with various partner organisations, we ensure the medical care of the population and have also specialized in high-level old age medicine. Ms. Monique Huismann, Department of Physiotherapy
